title: Mass of a Planar Triangular Shell with Linear Density
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the mass of the triangular surface x + y + z = 1 in the first octant if density is delta(x, y, z) = x.

steps.title: Determine Surface Area Element d sigma
steps.mathExpression: z = 1 - x - y \implies z_x = -1, \; z_y = -1; \quad d\sigma = \sqrt{1 + 1 + 1} \, dA = \sqrt{3} \, dA

steps.title: Set Up and Evaluate Double Integral
steps.mathExpression: M = \iint_T x (\sqrt{3} \, dA) = \sqrt{3} \int_0^1 x \left( \int_0^{1-x} dy \right) dx = \sqrt{3} \int_0^1 x(1 - x) \, dx = \sqrt{3} \left( \frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{3} \right) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}
